classification_rule.case_a: baseline is materially stable and at least one isolated query produces a material object-state change
classification_rule.case_b: strict digests change only through natural settling, isMoving, or sub-threshold pose jitter, with no isolated query-specific material change
classification_rule.no_change: neither baseline Pass nor isolated queries change strict object-state digests
classification_rule.inconclusive: a precondition, reset, or Pass fails; a failed query attempt is still assessed for its state effect and reported separately

privacy: public evidence contains digests, counts, booleans, thresholds, aggregate deltas, and field categories only; no objectId, coordinates, exact poses, or spawn coordinates
